title: Alpaca Agent connects a mount's guider for any client, blocking the Guider Agent
summary: With indigo_agent_alpaca loaded, indigo_alpaca_connect_paired_guider() connected '<mount> (guider)' whenever the mount connected, regardless of the requesting client. The Guider Agent then refused the guider as busy or in use (forum thread t=1413). Fixed by connecting the guider only after an Alpaca client's PUT connected=true on the mount.
evidence: Reproduced with indigo_server, mount_synscan serial simulator, agents mount/guider/alpaca: bus trace shows Change 'Mount SynScan (guider)'.'CONNECTION' from 'Alpaca Agent' 4 ms after the mount connected; selection in Guider Agent ended ALERT. See verification.md of the task.

resolution.evidence: Task 20261101163708-4785-fix-alpaca-guider-autoconnect verification.md: regression test paired_guider_follows_alpaca_client_only fails before and passes after the fix; server scenario with the SynScan simulator no longer connects the guider for the Mount Agent.
